title: Written Exposure Therapy for Childbirth-related Post-Traumatic Stress
official: Written Exposure Therapy (WET) for the Treatment of Childbirth-related Post-Traumatic Stress: A Pilot Study
summary: In this research study, the investigators hope to determine whether Written Exposure Therapy is a feasible intervention for postpartum women experiencing trauma symptoms related to childbirth to complete. Written Exposure Therapy involves five structured psychotherapy sessions that can be conducted over telehealth.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Birthing individuals
* 18 years of age or older
* Living in Massachusetts
* Can read, write, and speak English
* Identified a traumatic event exposure related to their childbirth experience
* Are between one month to two years postpartum
* Have a probable CB-PTSD diagnosis based on a PCL-5 score ≥ 28.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current engagement in another form of trauma-focused psychotherapy
* No or little memory of the traumatic event
* Safety concerns including active suicidality, active psychosis, and heavy substance use with inability to cease substance use for at least 2 hours before and after each session.
